item.title: UK Discord users were part of a Peter Thiel-linked data collection experiment
item.description:
📝 Discord have belatedly confirmed that they're working with Persona, an identity detection firm backed by a fund directed by Palantir chairman Peter Thiel, as part of Discord's new global age verification system rollout. Never mind that Discord assured us earlier that "identity documents submitted to our vendors are deleted quickly--in most cases, immediately after age confirmation. It's not like Thiel joints have a track record of working with any bloodthirsty snoops.
🔗 Read more: https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/good-news-uk-discord-users-were-part-of-a-peter-thiel-linked-data-collection-experiment

item.title: Show HN: Maths, CS and AI Compendium
item.description:

Background Over the past 7 years working in AI/ML, I filled notebooks with intuition first, real-world context, no hand-waving explanations of maths, computing and AI concepts. Outline # Chapter Summary Status 01 Vectors Spaces, magnitude, direction, norms, metrics, dot/cross/outer products, basis, duality Available 02 Matrices Properties, special types, operations, linear Descriptive measures, sampling, central limit theorem, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals Available 05 Probability Counting, conditional probability, distributions, Bayesian methods, information
